title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
background: The UEFA Nations League is a competition for European national teams.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UEFA's official match result and contemporaneous reporting of the completed match. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.
